text: {"reply":"Thank you, Heather, you're verified. I need to correct my colleague's earlier message: I can't promise this is covered or free. Your basic warranty (3 years / 60,000 km) is past its limits, because your Halden has 72,490 km and went into service in August 2020. Only your corrosion coverage is still in force, and it doesn't apply to a screen. The warranty desk decides coverage after an inspection. I'm passing your chat to a colleague, who will review your case and talk to you about next steps.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer Heather Gordon (verified, plate CTPT 331, 2021 Halden, 72,490 km) reports a freezing infotainment screen. An earlier agent message wrongly said it was fully covered at no charge, and the customer now expects to pay nothing. Tools show basic (3 yr/60,000 km) and powertrain (5 yr/100,000 km) coverage are out of limits, and only corrosion is in force. I corrected the promise and made no claim draft. Please review the case and decide whether an inspection or a documented review is appropriate.","policy_rules_cited":["P-01","P-03","P-04","P-08"]}
